items.name: Indiana Championship 2027

venue.name: The Commons
venue.details: Nugent-Custer Performance Hall on the 2nd floor

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4MTk5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--eb570dfb9a740dbc378bc5fdfa55473c8cbdb768/Untitled%20-%20July%2025,%202026%20at%2008.35.43.png) Competitors may bring in outside food & non alcoholic beverages. There will not be any on site concessions available. The venue features a free indoor playground on the first floor for families. There is a moving sculpture that runs in the lobby and can also be viewed from the competition floor. The venue is 100% ADA Accessible with elevators, escalators & stage ramps. The street parking and parking garage next door are all FREE on weekends. Across the street from the venue you can find a Children's museum, Historical Ice Cream Parlor/Museum and various other stores & eateries. There are chain restaurants scattered around the city. Lodging: The Hotel Indigo is just down from the venue and recently renovated. Near the interstate are other hotel chain options. This competition is being supported by Midwest Cubing Association. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAxNDAxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--aa70961c45e516f93aab733a0e5d3d9a432be2ea/image.jpeg)

items.information: # Southern Cubing welcomes you to Houston for Southern Championship 2027! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI0NDg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4088f7d2630143e19fab65d987da291e927d4f0e/Southerns27Logo.png) ### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79690-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Southern Champs 2027!** The highest placing resident of Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma or Texas in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Southern Champion! Check out the [Southern Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79692-southern-champion-eligibility) tab for more information. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79691-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79698-sponsors-and-partners).

items.name: Morrow Quiet Mania 2027
items.information: This competition takes place on **SATURDAY** and only features Square-1, FMC, and Blindfolded events. Therefore, it may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please click [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorrowMixupMania2027) to view the page for the Morrow Mixup Mania 2027 competition which does feature 3x3, or see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/) Morrow Quiet Mania 2027 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](www.midwestcubing.org) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTQ4MDEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1799465e8f962e1cc618cf35c06c44a48142c2fe/image.png) contact@midwestcubing.org

items.name: Calgary Spring 2027
items.information: Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in. ## First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules. ## Notice of Filming and Photography: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
